description: Head of household beneficiary with MAGI 150,000: uses the individual-return column.
worked:
Premium year 2026; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2024 tax return (two years back): 150,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2026 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the individual tax return column (single, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse, married filing separately and lived apart all year): 150,000 is greater than 137,000 and less than or equal to 171,000.
Part B: standard premium 202.90 + income-related adjustment 202.90 = total monthly premium 405.80.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 37.50 (added to the plan premium).
